comment.body:
Hi @dadezzz.  Thanks for the more detailed steps; I've reproduced the issue.  👍

I believe that #14243 may have amplified one inconsistent behaviour in how non-restricted users are treated for public repositories -- some of the previous code paths would not write their access table records, and some would.  The centralized behaviour was to *not* write their records, but this behaviour is not correct as it causes problems with the repo search (as you've found), as well as few other subtle application areas.

Proposed patch in #15099.
